articles.title: Russian spacecraft maneuvers in "extreme proximity" to satellite used by Ukraine
articles.summary: A Russian military satellite maneuvered in “extreme proximity” of a commercial Earth-imaging satellite in recent days in the first known example an unsanctioned rendezvous in low-Earth orbit, according to the orbital intelligence company LeoLabs.

articles.title: Batteries help reduce emissions, but how do we reduce their emissions?
articles.summary: The first order of business for the energy transition is electrifying applications like vehicles and heating and making sure that the electricity that powers them is made using renewables.
